name: crew
description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow, plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, live activity, context, tokens and time (cost estimate optional).

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, fr, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: savvy: when a savvy-flow worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts

showCost.title: Show the cost estimate
showCost.description: Draw the estimated cost in the agents panel; off, only tokens and time are shown
